text:
An old and expensive steel watch becomes magnetised.
The owner wants to use the watch again. He must demagnetise the watch.
What is the best method to do this?
A
Insert the watch in a solenoid that carries alternating current and then slowly remove it.
B
Insert the watch in a solenoid that carries direct current and then slowly remove it.
C
Pass alternating current through the watch.
D
Pass direct current through the watch.

options.label: A
options.text: Insert the watch in a solenoid that carries alternating current and then slowly remove it.

options.label: B
options.text: Insert the watch in a solenoid that carries direct current and then slowly remove it.

options.label: C
options.text: Pass alternating current through the watch.

options.label: D
options.text: Pass direct current through the watch.
